body:
I have had anxiety issues for decades.  I am on 10 mg of Paxil and take Lorazepam .25 mg when a little extra help is needed.  I stay away from stimulants and I haven't had any caffeine or stimulants  as they cause jitters and cause anxiety.
I have tried a few legal alternatives to relax in attempts to not need the Lorazepam.
I am trying the white and red vein variety's.  At the moment, I am enjoying my hours on the Red Vein.  I have taken 4 teaspoons of the powder.  2 the first hour, and 2 the second hour.  I've taken it on an empty stomach.  I don't mind the taste, I empty the powder on my tongue, take a little water, mix it up in my mouth and swallow.
Although I am currently in the middle of this current experience, it is not my first, as I dosed up about a week ago as well.   I feel stimulated and relaxed at the same time.  For me, that is a unique feeling.  I'm used to one or the other, but I feel motivated to do things, not sleepy, mind feels sharp, and yet, I have a very nice warm feeling through out my body and a sense of calm.  It has actually been quite euphoric.
I did have a little stomach cramping from my last experience for a couple days after.
I did have a little stomach cramping from my last experience for a couple days after.
As long as I stayed on top of keeping my bowels empty, it was fine.  The come down has not caused me anxiety.
People in the past have suggested I take weed to relax me, and although it works, the come down causes me anxiety and kills the whole point.  My plan is the have this as a 2 to 3 times a month experience.
